bullets.text: Autopsiya va gistologiya tekshiruvning tayanchi bo‘lib qoladi. Shunga qaramay, 10–15% hollarda to‘liq tekshiruvdan keyin ham o‘lim sababi aniqlanmaydi.

bullets.text: Immunogistokimyo oddiy bo‘yashda ko‘rinmaydigan o‘zgarishni topadi. Fibronektin ishemiyani 1 soat ichida ko‘rsatadi, gematoksilin–eozin (H&E) esa hali manfiy bo‘ladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Jarohat hayotiyligini aniqlashda oddiy gistologiyaning aniqligi atigi 66%. Glikoforin A (GPA) bilan bo‘yash qon to‘kilishini ancha ishonchli topadi.

bullets.text: Immunogistokimyo mutaxassis tajribasi va uzoqroq ishlov vaqtini talab qiladi. Ammo u hayotiylik reaksiyasi va jarohat vaqtini aniqroq ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.

Doskada: ’oddiy gistologiya → immunogistokimyo‘ ketma-ketligini ikki ustunli sxemada chizdiring. Tipik xato: H&E manfiy bo‘lsa, o‘zgarish yo‘q deb hisoblash.

slides.title: Ikki manba va ma’ruza rejasi

bullets.text: 1-manba: yurak o‘limida biomarkerlar — oqsil, peptid, yallig‘lanish va molekulyar belgilar.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: 2-manba: GPA yordamida chirigan tanada jarohat hayotiyligini aniqlash; 16 ta tadqiqot tahlil qilingan.

source.author: Donato Morena va boshq.
source.title: Bloody Evidence: The Validity of Glycophorin A in the Determination of Wound Vitality—A Systematic Review of the Literature, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ikkalasini bog‘laydi: gistologiyaga immunogistokimyo qo‘shilsa, diagnostik qiymat eng yuqori bo‘ladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega ikki xil mavzu (yurak o‘limi va jarohat hayotiyligi) bitta ma’ruzada birlashtirilgan? 2) Ikkala holatda ham gistologiya qaysi muammoni hal qilolmaydi? Doskada: besh bosqichli zanjirni chizib, har bosqich ostiga manbani yozing. Tipik xato: ikki manbani bir-biriga bog‘liq bo‘lmagan mavzu deb qabul qilish.

slides.title: To‘satdan yurak o‘limi: ta’rif va sabablar

bullets.text: To‘satdan yurak o‘limi (TYO‘): belgidan 1 soat ichida, guvohsiz bo‘lsa 24 soat ichida kutilmagan o‘lim.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: TYO‘ tabiiy o‘limlarning taxminan 15–20% ini, yiliga 4–5 million o‘limni tashkil etadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: to‘liq tekshiruvdan keyin 10–15% hol sababsiz (autopsiya-manfiy) qoladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega ta’rifda ’guvohsiz’ holat uchun 24 soat alohida ko‘rsatilgan? 2) Yosh bemorda gistologiya normal bo‘lsa, qaysi sabablar o‘ylanadi? Doskada: yosh o‘qi bo‘ylab ikki guruhni va ularning sabablarini chizdiring. Tipik xato: barcha TYO‘ ni koronar kasallikka bog‘lash.

slides.title: Autopsiya-manfiy o‘lim muammosi

bullets.text: To‘satdan yurak o‘limi (TYO‘) tabiiy o‘limlarning taxminan 15–20 foizini beradi. Dunyoda yiliga taxminan 4–5 million o‘lim bilan bog‘liq.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: To‘liq autopsiya va gistologiyadan keyin ham 10–15% holat tushuntirilmay qoladi. Ular “autopsiya-manfiy to‘satdan tushuntirilmagan o‘lim” deb ataladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Bunday holatda oila aniq izohsiz, sud yetarli isbotsiz, shifokor esa profilaktika uchun zarur ma’lumotsiz qoladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Autopsiya va gistologiya asosiy usul bo‘lib qoladi. Bo‘shliqni to‘ldirish uchun post-mortem biokimyo va molekulyar usullar qo‘shiladi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega gistologiya manfiy bo‘lsa ham o‘lim sababi bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) “Autopsiya-manfiy” atamasi nimani anglatadi? Doskada: markazda “TYO‘”, undan ikki shoxli chizma — “sabab topildi” va “10–15% tushuntirilmadi”. Tipik xato: “autopsiya-manfiy” ni “o‘lim sababi yo‘q” deb tushunish; aslida sabab asosiy usullar bilan ko‘rinmagan.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: gistologiya sababni ko‘rsatmadi

bullets.text: Vaziyat (o‘quv misol): yosh shaxs to‘satdan vafot etgan. Autopsiya va oddiy gistologiyada aniq o‘lim sababi topilmadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Yoshlarda ko‘pincha kardiomiopatiya, miokardit yoki irsiy aritmik sindromlar uchraydi. Ularning ba’zi asoslari oddiy gistologiyada ko‘rinmaydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Keyingi qadamlar: immunogistokimyo (fibronektin, C5b-9, desmin, S100A1), biokimyo, so‘ng gen tahlili (molekulyar autopsiya).

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: oila a’zolari uchun nima qilish mumkin? Gen varianti topilsa, kaskadli skrining xavf ostidagi qarindoshlarni aniqlaydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Bu o‘quv vaziyati bo‘lib, manbadagi umumiy ma’lumotlardan tuzilgan. Muhokama: 1) Birinchi navbatda qaysi usul qo‘llanadi va nega? 2) Genetik topilma oilaga nima beradi? Doskada: bosqichlar zanjirini chizing — autopsiya → gistologiya → immunogistokimyo → biokimyo → molekulyar tahlil. Tipik xato: bosqichlarni o‘tkazib, darhol genetik testga o‘tish.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: TYO‘ ta’rifi

bullets.text: Savol: TYO‘ ta’rifida simptom boshlanganidan qancha vaqt ichida o‘lim yuz beradi? To‘g‘ri javob: 1 soat ichida (guvohli holat).

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Guvohsiz holatda o‘lim shaxs oxirgi marta sog‘lom holda tirik ko‘rilganidan keyin 24 soat ichida yuz bergan bo‘lishi kerak.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — 1 soat ≠ 24 soat. Birinchisi guvohli holatga, ikkinchisi guvohsiz holatga tegishli.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ta’rif kutilmagan tabiiy o‘limni, taxminiy yurak kelib chiqishini nazarda tutadi. 35 yoshdan oshganlarda ko‘proq koronar arteriya kasalligi uchraydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

(yo‘q, yosh faqat sabablarga ta’sir qiladi). Doskada: ikki ustunli jadval chizing — “guvohli: 1 soat” va “guvohsiz: 24 soat”. Tipik xato: ikkala vaqtni aralashtirib yuborish.

slides.title: Miokard nekrozining oqsil markerlari

bullets.text: Yurak troponinlari (cTnI, cTnT) kardiomiotsit nekrozining eng maxsus va sezgir markeri hisoblanadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: CK-MB ≠ troponin. CK-MB (kreatinkinaza-MB) travma, tutqanoq va mushak jarohatida ham oshadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Ikkalasining mos oshishi qisqa PMI (o‘limdan keyingi vaqt)da o‘tkir ishemik o‘limni tasdiqlaydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega CK-MB faqat o‘zi yetarli emas? 2) hs-troponin (yuqori sezgir test) gistologiyadan nimasi bilan ustun? Doskada: troponin va CK-MB ustunli jadvalni chizdiring. Tipik xato: CK-MB oshishini avtomatik yurak o‘limi deb baholash.

slides.title: H-FABP, GPBB va multimarker yondashuv

bullets.text: H-FABP (yurak yog‘ kislotasi bog‘lovchi oqsili) tez ajraladi, ammo PMI uzayganda tez parchalanadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: GPBB (glikogen fosforilaza BB) erta ishemiyani bildiradi; panelda troponin bilan sezgirlikni oshiradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Mutlaq qiymat o‘rniga nisbat (perikard/qon) va panel ishonchliroq; chegara qat’iy emas.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega erta ishemiya markerlari uzoq PMI da ishonchsiz? 2) Panel bitta markerdan nimasi bilan yaxshi? Doskada: zanjirni chizib, har bosqichga misol yozdiring. Tipik xato: H-FABP yoki GPBB ni uzoq PMI da yagona dalil sifatida ishlatish.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: perikard suyuqligi va qon

bullets.text: Vaziyat: kutilmagan o‘lim, PMI 24–48 soatdan oshgan, gistologiyada ishemiya belgisi aniq emas.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Perikard suyuqligidagi troponin qondagiga qaraganda uzoqroq barqaror, shuning uchun uni son venasi qoni bilan solishtiring.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Perikard/son venasi qoni troponin nisbati PMI va gemoliz ta’sirini kamaytiradi; mutlaq chegaradan afzal.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: qaysi muhit va nisbat tanlanadi? Markaziy yurak qoni nega sun’iy yuqori qiymat berishi mumkin?

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Javob: perikard suyuqligi va son venasi qonida troponin o‘lchanib, ularning nisbati baholanadi. Markaziy yurak qoni miokarddan sizib chiqish tufayli sun’iy yuqori qiymat berishi mumkin. Muhokama: 1) H-FABP bu holatda nega kam ishonchli? 2) Nisbiy talqin sudda nima uchun himoyaviy? Doskada: perikard va son venasi namunalarini sxema qilib chizdiring. Tipik xato: klinik chegara qiymatini o‘limdan keyingi namunaga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qo‘llash.

slides.title: Peptid markerlar: gemodinamik stress

bullets.text: B-tipli natriuretik peptid (BNP), NT-proBNP, kopeptin va sST2 nekrozni emas, gemodinamik stressni aks ettiradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Perikard suyuqligidagi NT-proBNP qon redistributsiyasidan himoyalangan va 24–48 soat nisbatan barqaror.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Eng kuchli natijani yakka peptid emas, ko‘p markerli panel beradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega perikard suyuqligi qondan ishonchliroq bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) Buyrak yetishmovchiligi NT-proBNP talqiniga qanday ta’sir qiladi? Doskada chizish: jadvalni 3 ustunda (peptid, nimani ko‘rsatadi, cheklov) o‘zlari to‘ldirsin. Tipik xato: peptidlarni nekroz markeri deb o‘ylash; nekrozni asosan troponinlar ko‘rsatadi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: kopeptin va troponin birgalikda

bullets.text: Bemor shifoxonaga tushgach ko‘p o‘tmay yiqilib vafot etdi. Otopsiyada aniq lezion topilmadi, infarktni o‘tkazib yuborish ehtimoli ko‘tarildi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Post-mortem qonda kopeptin troponinlar bilan birga yuqori bo‘lgan. Bu yiqilish paytida o‘tkir ishemiya bo‘lganini ko‘rsatgan (Kutlu va boshq.).

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Shu tariqa o‘tkazib yuborilgan klinik tashxisni keyinchalik qayta tiklash mumkin. Me’yoriy darajalar esa shifokorni asossiz ayblovdan himoya qilishi mumkin.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol: nega kopeptin yolg‘iz o‘zi emas, aynan troponin bilan birga talqin qilinishi kerak?

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Biomarkerlar da’vogar va himoya tomoniga qanday ikki yoqlama xizmat qiladi? 2) Kopeptin nimani, troponin nimani isbotlaydi? Kutilgan javob: troponin nekrozni, kopeptin tizimli stress javobini ko‘rsatadi, ular bir-birini to‘ldiradi. Doskada chizish: voqea zanjirini (shifoxonaga tushish, yiqilish, otopsiya, biomarker, xulosa) chizdiring. Tipik xato: biomarkerni yagona dalil deb qabul qilish; kontekst va PMI hisobga olinishi shart.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: peptidlar va nekroz markerlari

bullets.text: Savol 1: qaysi marker miokard nekrozini ko‘rsatadi? Javob: yurak troponinlari, ular eng o‘ziga xos va sezgir marker hisoblanadi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Savol 2: gemodinamik stressni qaysi markerlar ko‘rsatadi? Javob: BNP va NT-proBNP, kopeptin hamda sST2.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi — kopeptin ≠ yurakka xos marker. U sepsis, travma va insultda ham oshishi mumkin, shuning uchun kontekst zarur.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Kopeptin troponinni almashtirmaydi, balki to‘ldiradi. Troponin, H-FABP va kopeptin birgalikda ishemik SCD uchun 90% dan yuqori aniqlik bergan.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Talabalarga markerlarni ro‘yxat qilib berib, har birini «nekroz» yoki «stress» guruhiga ajratishni so‘rang. Muhokama: nega kopeptin yurakka xos emas? Doskada chizish: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat (nekroz markerlari va stress markerlari). Tipik xato: kopeptinni yurak kasalligining aniq belgisi deb hisoblash; SCD qisqartmasi — to‘satdan yurak o‘limi.

slides.title: Yallig‘lanish va immunogistokimyo (IGK)

bullets.text: CRP (C-reaktiv oqsil) va IL-6 (interleykin-6) eruvchan mediatorlardir. Ular yallig‘lanish haqidagi farazni qo‘llab-quvvatlashi mumkin.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: CRP va IL-6 gipoksiya, uzoq agoniya va terminal stressda ham oshadi. Oshishi yallig‘lanishni isbotlamaydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: IGK markerlari to‘qimada hayotiy reaksiyani ko‘rsatadi va jarohatni vaqt bo‘yicha aniqroq bosqichlashga yordam beradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Eruvchan sitokinlar arzon, lekin parchalanadi va bakteriya o‘tishidan buziladi. IGK mahoratni va ko‘proq vaqtni talab qiladi, ammo gistologiya bilan eng kuchli natija beradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega CRP oshishi yallig‘lanishni to‘liq isbotlamaydi? 2) IGK eruvchan markerlardan qaysi jihatlari bilan ustun? Doskada chizish: ikki ustunli solishtirish (eruvchan mediatorlar va to‘qima IGK) – afzallik va kamchilik. Tipik xato: talabalar CRP va IL-6 ni o‘ziga xos marker deb hisoblaydi.

slides.title: Erta ishemiyaning IGK belgilari

bullets.text: Bu markerlar H&E (gematoksilin-eozin) bo‘yog‘ida ko‘rinmaydigan erta ishemiyani aniqlashga yordam beradi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: C5b-9 o‘tkir ishemik o‘limda aniqlanadi; noishemik yoki surunkali holatlarda bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Sacco MA va boshq.
source.title: Post-Mortem Biomarkers in Sudden Cardiac Death: From Classical Biochemistry to Molecular Autopsy and Multi-Omics Forensic Approaches, International Journal of Molecular Sciences

bullets.text: Diqqat: C5b-9 – to‘planish belgisi; S100A1 – yo‘qolish belgisi. Ikkalasi ham ishemiyani bildiradi.

Perikard suyuqligi anatomik ajralganligi uchun qayta taqsimlanishdan himoyalangan. Markaziy yurak qoni esa miokarddan oqib chiqish tufayli sun’iy yuqori qiymat berishi mumkin.

mcq.question: NT-proBNP ni o‘lgandan keyin aniqlashda perikard suyuqligi qonga nisbatan nima uchun ishonchliroq hisoblanadi?
options: U gemolizga eng sezgir, shuning uchun signal kuchayadi
U anatomik ajralgan va post-mortem qayta taqsimlanishdan himoyalangan
U klinik chegara qiymatlarga har doim to‘liq mos keladi
U vazopressinning o‘zini barqaror holda saqlab turadi
mcq.explanation: Manbaga ko‘ra, BNP va NT-proBNP qon hamda perikard suyuqligida aniqlanadi. Perikard suyuqligi post-mortem qayta taqsimlanishdan himoyalangani uchun ishonchliroq. Qolgan variantlar manbaga zid: gemoliz ishonchlilikni oshirmaydi, universal klinik chegaralar o‘limdan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qo‘llanmaydi, vazopressin emas, kopeptin barqaror.

Kollaps paytida o‘tkir ishemiya bo‘lganini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi
mcq.explanation: Manbada Kutlu va hamkasblari tadqiqoti keltirilgan: troponin bilan birga yuqori kopeptin kollaps paytidagi o‘tkir ishemiyani ko‘rsatgan. mcq.question: Koronar arteriya tiqilishidan taxminan 1 soat o‘tib o‘lim yuz berdi. Gematoksilin–eozin bo‘yashda o‘zgarish yo‘q. Ishemik shikastni ko‘rsatishi mumkin bo‘lgan eng mos keyingi qadam qaysi?
options: Fibronektinni sarkolemma bo‘ylab IGK bilan aniqlash
Faqat femoral qonda IL-6 darajasini o‘lchash
Faqat femoral qonda CRP darajasini o‘lchash
Preparatni yana o‘sha H&E bilan qayta ko‘rish
mcq.explanation: Manbaga ko‘ra, sarkolemma bo‘ylab fibronektin ajralishi ishemik shikastning eng erta belgilaridan biri. IGK uni koronar tiqilishdan 1 soat ichida, H&E hali manfiy bo‘lganda ham ko‘rsatishi mumkin. CRP va IL-6 nospesifik, gipoksiya va uzoq agoniyada ham ko‘tarilishi mumkin. IGK – immunogistokimyo.

mcq.question: Eruvchan sitokinlarga (CRP, IL-6) nisbatan to‘qimadagi IGK markerlarining asosiy afzalligi nima?
options: Ular arzonroq va maxsus mutaxassissiz bajariladi
Ular tezroq bajariladi va post-mortem o‘zgarmaydi
Ular hayotiy reaksiyani va shikast vaqtini aniqroq ko‘rsatadi
mcq.explanation: Manbada eruvchan sitokinlar oson va arzon, lekin post-mortem parchalanishga va bakterial translokatsiyaga moyil, shuning uchun spetsifikligi past deyilgan. IGK markerlari hayotiy reaksiyaning kuchliroq isbotini va ishemiya vaqtini beradi, lekin maxsus malaka va uzoqroq ishlov talab qiladi.

mcq.question: Autopsiyada femoral qonda CRP yuqori topildi. Bu ishemik o‘limga nisbatan qaysi mexanizmni ko‘proq qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi?
options: Miokardit yoki sepsis bilan bog‘liq yallig‘lanishni
mcq.explanation: Manbaga ko‘ra, femoral qonda CRP miokardit va sepsisdagi o‘limlarda ishemik to‘satdan o‘limdagiga qaraganda yuqoriroq bo‘lgan. Biroq CRP sistemali gipoksiya, uzoq agoniya va terminal stressda ham ko‘tarilishi mumkin, shuning uchun natija yordamchi dalil sifatida talqin qilinadi.

mcq.question: Yosh odamning yuragi tuzilishi jihatidan me‘yorda, gistologiya ham manfiy. Qaysi molekulyar belgi ishemik o‘limni aritmik o‘limdan farqlashga yordam beradi?
mcq.explanation: Yurakka xos mikroRNKlar (miR-1, miR-133, miR-208, miR-499) o‘limdan keyin barqaror. Ularning alohida imzolari tuzilish o‘zgarishisiz ishemik va aritmik o‘limni ajratishga yordam beradi. CRP esa nospetsifik, jasad tashqi ko‘rinishi va bakteriya miqdori bunday farqlashni bermaydi.

mcq.question: Molekulyar autopsiyada kanalopatiyalar (LQTS, Brugada, CPVT) bilan eng ko‘p bog‘lanadigan genlar to‘plami qaysi?
mcq.explanation: SCN5A, KCNQ1, KCNH2 va RYR2 natriy, kaliy va kalsiy kanallari subbirliklarini kodlaydi. PKP2, DSP, DSG2, DSC2 desmosomal genlar bo‘lib, ARVCga (aritmogen o‘ng qorincha kardiomiopatiyasi) xos. MYH7, LMNA, DES kardiomiopatiya genlari, MYH6, COX5B va CACNA1A esa yangi paydo bo‘layotgan lokuslar.

mcq.question: Ekspert troponinni markaziy yurak qonidan o‘lchab, yuqori natija oldi. Bu natijada qanday xato xavfi bor?
options: Mahalliy miokard oqishi tufayli sun‘iy oshgan qiymat
Qon tarkibidagi troponinning to‘liq parchalanib ketishi
Natijaning hamma holatda g‘ayritabiiy past chiqishi
mcq.explanation: Markaziy yurak qonida mahalliy miokard oqishi sababli qiymatlar sun‘iy oshgan bo‘lishi mumkin. Shu sababli son qon ko‘proq afzal ko‘riladi, perikard suyuqligi esa ishonchli muqobil hisoblanadi.

mcq.question: Bemor shifoxonaga kelgach qulab o‘ldi, autopsiyada aniq lezyon yo‘q. Qonda troponin bilan birga kopeptin ham yuqori. Bu nimani ko‘rsatadi?
options: O‘lim tashqi jarohat tufayli yuz berganini
Klinik tashxis hamma holda to‘g‘ri bo‘lganini
mcq.explanation: Troponin bilan birga kopeptinning yuqori bo‘lishi qulash paytida o‘tkir ishemiya bo‘lganini bildirgan. Bu o‘tkazib yuborilgan miokard infarkti tashxisini retrospektiv qayta tiklashga imkon beradi. Me‘yoriy qiymatlar esa shifokorni nohaq ayblovdan himoya qilishi mumkin.

mcq.question: Koronar okklyuziyadan taxminan 1 soat o‘tgan, gematoksilin–eozin (H&E) bo‘yalishi manfiy. Qaysi usul ishemik shikastni ko‘rsata oladi?
mcq.explanation: Sarkolemma bo‘ylab fibronektin yig‘ilishi ishemik shikastning eng erta belgilaridan biri. U okklyuziyadan taxminan bir soat o‘tgach, H&E hali manfiy bo‘lganda ham aniqlanadi. IL-6 esa nospetsifik bo‘lib, tashxis uchun yetarli emas.

mcq.question: Chirigan jasadda teri jarohati H&E bo‘yog‘ida eritrotsitlarni ko‘rsatmadi, GPA esa tomirdan tashqarida musbat chiqdi. Bu nimani bildiradi?
options: Jarohat o‘limdan keyin, qon aylanishi to‘xtagach hosil bo‘lgan
Jarohat tirikligida, qon aylanishi faol paytda hosil bo‘lgan
Musbat natija faqat o‘limdan keyingi gipostaz tufayli chiqqan
Musbat natija faqat chirishdagi teri rangi o‘zgarishiga bog‘liq
mcq.explanation: Tomirdan tashqarida joylashgan eritrotsitlar (GPA musbat) jarohat qon aylanishi faol paytda hosil bo‘lganini, ya’ni hayotiyligini ko‘rsatadi. Manfiy natija esa o‘limdan keyingi jarohatni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Maqolada GPA H&E da ko‘rinmagan eritrotsitlarni ham aniqlagani qayd etilgan.

mcq.question: Ushbu sistematik sharh qaysi hisobot yo‘riqnomasiga muvofiq bajarilgan?
options: JBI tanqidiy baholash ro‘yxatlari (xatolik xavfi uchun)
mcq.explanation: Sharh PRISMA yo‘riqnomasi bo‘yicha o‘tkazilgan. JBI vositalari faqat xatolik xavfini baholash uchun, Daubert mezonlari sudda dalilni baholash uchun, LSAB+ esa laboratoriya aniqlash tizimi sifatida tilga olingan.

mcq.question: Maqolaga ko‘ra, faqat oddiy gistologiya (H&E) ning diagnostik aniqligi qancha bo‘lgan?
mcq.explanation: Faqat gistologiyaning aniqligi 66% bo‘lgan: 18% holatda qon quyilish bor edi-yu aniqlanmagan, 16% da natija noaniq. 18% – o‘tkazib yuborilgan holatlar ulushi, 48 – GPA bilan bo‘yalgan namunalar soni, 72,2% – tajribadagi ko‘karishlarda GPA musbatligi.

mcq.question: Italiyadagi qayta ochilgan ishda o‘lim sababi deb hisoblangan jarohatlar GPA bo‘yicha manfiy, bo‘yinning laringotraxeal yumshoq to‘qimalari esa musbat chiqdi. Bu nimani ko‘rsatadi?
options: Jarohatlar tirikligida hosil bo‘lgan, o‘lim sababi o‘zgarmaydi
Natija suyak iligidagi hujayralar bilan kross-reaksiyadan chiqqan
Bo‘yindagi musbatlik gipostaz, ish avvalgidek yopiq qoladi
Bo‘yinda hayotiy qon quyilish, kuchli mexanik asfiksiya belgisi
mcq.explanation: Dastlabki jarohatlar GPA manfiy bo‘lgani uchun perimortem yoki postmortem hosil bo‘lgan deb baholandi. Bo‘yindagi musbatlik violent mexanik asfiksiyani ko‘rsatdi, shu sababli birinchi otopsiyadagi o‘z joniga qasd xulosasi o‘z kuchini yo‘qotdi.

mcq.question: Suyak iligi mavjud to‘qimada GPA musbat chiqdi, lekin tomirdan tashqarida qon quyilish belgisi yo‘q. Eng ehtimoliy sabab qaysi?
options: Eritroid prekursorlar bilan kross-reaksiya tufayli soxta musbat natija
Jarohat tirikligida hosil bo‘lganining mutlaq va aniq isboti bo‘ladi
Chirish tufayli antigen butunlay yo‘qolgan, natija soxta manfiy bo‘ladi
Antitana suyultirmasi noto‘g‘ri tanlangan, shuning uchun natija chiqmaydi
mcq.explanation: Maqolaning cheklovlar bo‘limida soxta musbat natija GPA ning eritroid prekursorlarga boy to‘qimalarda (suyak iligi, ekstramedullyar qon yaratilish o‘choqlari) aniqlanishi bilan bog‘langan. Shuning uchun natijani to‘qima turi va qon quyilish bilan birga baholash kerak.
